user.title: Off-grid Protection
user.description:
Configure Off-grid Protection.

### 📚 Documentation

[📖 Configuration (English)](https://github.com/imehun/off-grid-protection/blob/main/CONFIGURATION.md)

[📚 Konfiguracija (Hrvatski)](https://github.com/imehun/off-grid-protection/blob/main/CONFIGURATION_hr.md)

type.title: Configuration type
type.description: Select what you want to configure.

central.title: Central Setup
central.description: Configure the central Off-grid Protection system.

data_description.inverter_off_grid_status: Sensor that reports whether the inverter is On-grid or Off-grid.
data_description.power_meter_status: Sensor that reports whether the power meter is Normal or Offline.
data_description.recovery_delay: Time to wait after the protection cycle before checking the grid status again, in seconds.
data_description.central_pin: PIN used for central override authorization.
data_description.pin_check: Require the central PIN when an override is activated.
data_description.recovery_enabled: Enable automatic recovery after the grid returns.
data_description.logs: Enable OGP operational messages in the Home Assistant System Log.

climate.title: Climate configuration
climate.description: Configure the shutdown and recovery behavior for this climate device.

data_description.wait_for_unavailable: If the device is unavailable, OGP waits for it to return during the Recovery timeout. The Command timeout applies only to the shutdown command after the recovery waiting phase.

switch.title: Switch configuration
switch.description: Configure the shutdown and recovery behavior for this switch device.

data_description.wait_for_unavailable: If the device is unavailable, OGP waits for it to return during the Recovery timeout. The Command timeout applies only to the shutdown command after the recovery waiting phase.

custom.title: Custom device configuration
custom.description: Configure a generic device entity and a control entity for this Custom device.

data_description.recovery_action: Action to apply to the Control entity after ON-GRID recovery.
data_description.control_entity_id: Entity used by OGP to disable the Custom device control and optionally re-enable it during recovery.
data_description.wait_for_unavailable: If the device is unavailable, OGP waits for it to return during the Recovery timeout. The Command timeout applies only to the shutdown command after the recovery waiting phase.

automations.title: Associated automations
automations.description: Select the Home Assistant automations associated with this device.

data_description.automations: Select automations associated with the selected device.
data_description.show_all_automations: Show all Home Assistant automations instead of only associated automations.

override.title: Override configuration
override.description: Configure the override behavior for this device.

lovelace_language.title: Lovelace YAML language
lovelace_language.description: Select the language for the generated Lovelace YAML.

generate.title: Generate Lovelace YAML
generate.description: Optionally generate the Lovelace YAML instructions for this device.

central_notifications.title: House power status notifications
central_notifications.description: Select where OGP should send notifications about grid or battery operation.

data_description.notify_targets: Select one or more available notify recipients.
data_description.browser_mod_targets: Select one or more Browser Mod devices for popups.
data_description.notification_language: Language of the generated OGP automation and messages.
data_description.send_notification: Send a notification to the selected notify recipients when the house operating mode changes.
data_description.send_popup: Show a Browser Mod popup on the selected devices when the house operating mode changes.
data_description.notify_grid_status: Send notifications when the house changes between grid and battery operation.
data_description.notify_protection_status: Send notifications when a device is locked or an Override starts or ends.
data_description.notify_security: Send notifications for rejected Override attempts caused by an invalid PIN.
data_description.notification_mode: Choose one global notification configuration or configure notifications separately for each notify recipient and Browser Mod device.

custom_notification_targets.title: Notification targets
custom_notification_targets.description: Select the notify recipients and Browser Mod devices that should receive OGP notifications.

data_description.notify_targets: Select the Home Assistant notify recipients available for OGP notifications.
data_description.browser_mod_targets: Select the Browser Mod devices available for OGP popups.
data_description.notification_language: Language of the generated OGP automation and messages.

custom_notification_preferences.title: Per-device notification settings
custom_notification_preferences.description: Select which notification events each selected recipient or Browser Mod device should receive.
